fato_historico: 1383: The male line of the Portuguese House of Burgundy becomes extinct with the death of King Fernando, leaving only his daughter Beatrice. Rival claimants begin a period of civil war and disorder.
energia_do_dia: The universe invites you to reflect on legacy and transition, much like a royal lineage shifting focus to new heirs. Perhaps you feel called to redefine your personal boundaries or reorganize your internal realm. It is a good time to consider how your own unique gifts can lead your life forward with grace, stability, and renewed personal power.
frase_do_dia: True strength lies in the quiet wisdom of your own steady heart.
significado_numero: Represents the transformative power of endings leading to beautiful new beginnings.
conselho: Trust your intuition when navigating unexpected changes in your daily schedule today.
